strongest_counterhypothesis: ACEF over-unifies cognition. Existing Frank component contracts plus a narrow task-scoped semantic transaction and/or belief-commit protocol can provide the same safety and recovery correctness with lower runtime, compiler, storage and mental-model complexity.
evidence_for_counterhypothesis: Cordon already provides a task-wide containment boundary for multi-step tool workflows.
MemTX already provides transactional belief admission and cascade repair.
Current Frank already has state epochs/semantic transactions, graph invalidation, execution fencing and a strong effect lifecycle.
ACEF adds branch, causal-parent, monotonicity, visibility and commit-certificate metadata to many semantic writes.
Current ClayCode TypedIR/type-effect/compiler/runtime are not finished, so a universal fabric can increase the critical path.
evidence_for_ACEF: Current owner-fixed Frank acceptance requires causal closure across GWT, outcome, causal credit, learning and re-entry, not just memory or tool effects.

The synthetic discriminator shows a semantic case in which safe raw evidence retention can coexist with hidden outcome-conditioned belief state while using fewer modeled synchronous barriers than a full task transaction.
One delta-only admission boundary could remove multiple direct canonical mutation surfaces if the real implementation inventory confirms they exist.
Consistent-cut recovery has potential to connect state, identity lineage, lease epoch and unresolved external effects in one checkable frontier.
next_falsifier: Implement the smallest shadow ACEF path for one real Frank episode and compare against CURRENT_FRANK_CONTRACTS and TASK_TX on crash/replay correctness plus p50/p95/p99 latency, writes, bytes and recovery ambiguity on the accepted target VPS.
